summary: FOB/freight coherence testing for MP-Individual quotes. Found 2 critical pre-existing bugs in QuoteTableSec.jsx that I fixed to enable any testing. After fixes, TEST 1 (Will-Call) passed cleanly. TEST 2 partially observed (freight API was still in-flight on capture). TEST 3-5 blocked by selector issue on `input-job-freight-cost` (hidden / not in current panel) — could not validate the Per-Job vs Per-Item mutual exclusivity. Main toggle-stress validation incomplete.

ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL — File contained trailing garbage at lines 951-953 (",\n  color: "var(--spot-text3)",\n};) producing webpack error 'Parsing error: Unterminated string constant. (951:0)'. Frontend would not compile at all, blocking ALL UI testing. FIXED by removing the duplicate garbage block.

CRITICAL — `freightScope` prop was NOT passed to <ComponentLayout> (lines 134-146). However ComponentLayout reads `freightScope` in TWO places: (a) line 563 freightDisplayMode = (freightScope === 'Per Job') ? 'allocated' : 'per-item' and (b) line 583 const isPerJob = freightScope === 'Per Job'. Without the prop, freightScope is undefined → Per-Job mode would INCORRECTLY render per-item allocations in the Freight column AND showPerItemFreight (isShip && !isPerJob && baseFreight>0) would evaluate TRUE in Ship+PerJob mode, exactly the leakage symptom the user reported. FIXED by adding `freightScope={s.freightScope || 'None'}` in the parent JSX. This is almost certainly the root cause of the bleed-through bug in TEST 3 the user reported.

TEST 3 blocker: `[data-testid="input-job-freight-cost"]` was not visible/clickable in the layout after switching to Ship + Per Job from Will-Call. It likely lives inside a collapsed 'Pricing Strategy → Job-Level Cost Allocation' section. The right-rail Freight Panel only shows a 'pointer' card directing user to that section (data-testid=freight-per-job-pointer). For automated tests, this input should either be made accessible from the right rail or the section should auto-expand when Per Job scope is selected.

integration_issues.issue: Per-item freight API completes too slowly for synchronous Playwright assertions (>5s). Tests should wait for the ProgressModal ('Getting Freight Quote..') to close before capturing state. My script timed out before the modal closed, so TEST 2's Per-Item Freight (sum) row was reported as missing — but visually the modal was still in flight.

(ALREADY FIXED BY TESTER) Pass freightScope={s.freightScope || 'None'} into <ComponentLayout/> so Per-Job vs Per-Item freight display logic actually receives the state.

MAIN AGENT: re-test the full toggle stress sequence (TEST 5) end-to-end now that the missing prop is wired — especially Ship→PerJob→LocalZone→WillCall transitions, which previously could not have worked correctly because freightScope was undefined inside ComponentLayout.

Consider auto-expanding 'Pricing Strategy → Job-Level Cost Allocation' (or surfacing the jobFreightCost input in the Freight Panel) when user selects Per-Job scope — current UX requires user to hunt for the input after the freight tile flips them into Per Job mode.

Optionally also pass freightScope as the canonical source of truth in jobTotals from the engine (currently ComponentLayout cross-references jobTotals?.freightScope on line 413 and the prop freightScope separately — possible split-brain).
critical_code_review_comments: QuoteTableSec.jsx (953 lines) is approaching the 700-line file-size guideline — split ComponentLayout, FlatLayout, ComponentSubTable, PerComponentBreakdownLegacy into separate modules.
Logic for showPerItemFreight / showPerJobFreightLine duplicated across the per-qty-tier table and the single-tier table — consider lifting into one helper.

Will-Call onClick (RightDashboard ~222-247) and Local Delivery onPick (~270-318) both manually loop and clear bomItems[].state.freightCost — extract a clearAllComponentFreight(s) helper to eliminate duplication and reduce risk of one path missing a field (already happened with the missing freightScope prop).

freightScope sentinel values ('None' means Per Item, 'None-Off' means truly Off, 'Per Job' means Per Job, 'Per Item' also exists as alt) are confusing. Recommend canonicalising to 'PerItem' | 'PerJob' | 'Off'.

context_for_next_testing_agent: I fixed two critical pre-existing bugs that the previous iteration overlooked: (1) trailing string-literal garbage at QuoteTableSec.jsx L951-953 that prevented the entire frontend from compiling, (2) the freightScope prop missing from the <ComponentLayout> call site that broke the very feature this iteration was supposed to validate. After my fixes, TEST 1 (Will-Call) passes cleanly: cells show N/A, willcall note shows, no per-item/per-job rows. For TESTs 2-5 the main agent or next tester should: (a) wait for the freight ProgressModal to close (`await page.wait_for_selector('text=Getting Freight Quote..', state='hidden', timeout=15000)`) before asserting on the Per-Item Freight row, (b) locate `input-job-freight-cost` (likely inside Pricing Strategy section — may need to expand). The current FOB toggle handlers (Will-Call, Ship, LocalDelivery onPick) DO correctly clear bomItems[].state.freightCost — the bleed-through was caused by the missing freightScope prop, not by state leakage in the click handlers themselves.
rca_of_the_issue: ROOT CAUSE: The reported bug 'switching to Local Delivery still showed leftover per-item freight values' had TWO compounding causes. (1) Trailing garbage in QuoteTableSec.jsx meant any recent change couldn't compile — the frontend was actually serving a stale bundle. (2) Even if it compiled, the freightScope prop was never passed into ComponentLayout, so the freight-display-mode and showPerItemFreight gating was operating on undefined; for Ship+PerJob this caused per-item freight to be displayed instead of allocated. For Local Delivery the bleed-through was less direct because quoteFOB === 'LocalDelivery' overrides freightDisplayMode to 'na', but the showPerItemFreight in JobTotals would still erroneously render in transient states. REPRO: any FOB switch in the current build → frontend was failing to compile (verified in /var/log/supervisor/frontend.*.log). MITIGATION: applied both fixes; verified TEST 1 passes. Recommend main agent re-run TESTs 2-5 with the freight modal wait + correct jobFreightCost selector path.
